frontier: Physical production need vs financially sustainable payroll wedge

activeExperiment.name: R4-Y / R4-Z Labor Coherence — ultra-sharded recovery run
activeExperiment.description: One principal regime now maps to one Actions job. First completed R4-Z artifacts pass all hard gates. Original-A CONSUMER production-need staffing cuts mean unemployment from 44.49% to 8.90% and raises output about 30%, but mean arrears rise 2.57x and linked/current-worker arrears 4.15x. Physical-need-only staffing is therefore not an admissible repair.

causalChain: Physical production labor requirements diverge from financially sustainable payroll capacity
Canonical requested labor is often below physical need but above realized/settlement-supported labor
Expanding staffing to physical need alone produces output while accumulating unpaid payroll
Current-worker wage arrears drive renewed liquidity distress
Repeated restructuring occurs and eventually gives way to liquidation
Firm exit propagates unemployment and inactive estates strand resources
Supply and demand weaken further, amplifying collapse

researchTimeline.result: Long-run collapse reproduced under controlled baseline.
Labor matching, voluntary consumption cuts, and single-factor credit explanations narrowed or rejected as primary roots.
Exit propagation identified as a major late-stage unemployment amplifier; generic root search closed.
Entrant credit timing and startup-finance defects confirmed, but aggregate employment impact remained secondary.
Estate stranding and accounting representation defects confirmed; tax-feedback root hypothesis falsified.
Restructure-vs-liquidate architecture shown to be economically material; supply relief becomes a complement after restructuring.

R4-V closed across all six seeds: total restructuring arrears rise while former-worker/orphan arrears fall; current-worker arrears dominate. Three completed 48m W shards reproduce the long-horizon trade-off.
Post-restructure payroll coverage remains severely inadequate and restructuring recurs across original and held-out seeds.

Ultra-sharding is producing valid artifacts. Early direct A comparison falsifies physical-need-only staffing as a repair: unemployment and output improve dramatically, but linked/current-worker arrears multiply. The frontier is now the wedge between physical labor need and sustainable payroll capacity.

notes: Diagnostic-only results are kept separate from canonical production repairs.
Observer instrumentation must not alter simulation state.
A PASS on accounting identity is not treated as proof of economic realism.
Physical production need alone is not a financially admissible staffing criterion.
Actions artifacts are supporting evidence, not the sole permanent record; closure-level evidence is committed to the repository.
